    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0]) if rows else 0
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c] == 8]
    if not cells:
        return []
    r0 = min(r for r, _ in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, _ in cells)
    c0 = min(c for _, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for _, c in cells)
    shape = [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in grid[r0:r1 + 1]]
    copies = sum(cell == 4 for row in grid for cell in row)
    return [row * copies for row in shape]
